arStrings.szText: We are too late. The Temple of Life has already come under attack by the same corruption spreading through the forest. How much destruction has Mephisto wrought here already? We must delve deeper into the Temple and continue our search for Lilith's blade.

An Amazon named Tharra has survived the onslaught on the Temple. She could prove to be a useful ally, if we win her trust. Tharra witnessed Lorath cut down Queen Adreona in Temis, and she has no intention to forgive him for his crime. We must clear the corruption from the Temple to prove we are not the enemies she thinks we are.
